name: Michael Leigh
text: You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat]. [reaction] After you successfully investigate: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Michael Leigh, as evidence (to a maximum of 3 evidence). [reaction] When you initiate an attack, exhaust Michael Leigh and spend 1 evidence: You deal +1 damage for this attack.
text_cn:
你获得+1[intellect]和+1[combat]。
[reaction]在你成功调查后：从供应堆拿取1资源放在迈克尔·利上，作为证据(最多3证据)。
[reaction]在你发动一次攻击时，消耗迈克尔·利并花费1证据：你这次攻击造成+1伤害。
